notes.title: Wetware update - days 10-12 (ending!)
notes.content: Days 10 - 12 of Wetware is now playable. Now you can play all the way to the ending!

notes.title: Hello (and join our Discord)!
notes.content:
Hey hey! Thanks for stumbling upon Wetware's Steam page!

We're glad you're interested in some robot hacking shenanigans. Do check often for updates as we keep working towards a release!

In the meantime, we also have a [url=https://discord.gg/jJjjtaa]Discord server[/url]! If you're interested in joining early alpha/beta tests, make sure to check the server out!
